title: preprocess-file
summary: Diagnostic that prints a file's {$IFDEF}-resolved source to stdout under a given define set

surfaces.usage: drag-lint preprocess-file --file PATH [--define SYM]... [--numeric K=V]... [--include-mode off|defines-only] [--no-near-search] [--tolerances] (diagnostic: print {$IFDEF}-resolved source to stdout)
